tasks.title: Add unit tests for notifications module
tasks.instructions: Create tests/test_notifications.py with pytest unit tests covering the public functions and classes in src/notifications.py. Follow the style of existing tests/test_auth.py and tests/test_orders.py. Use monkeypatch or fixtures for any external side effects such as sending messages or writing files. Ensure tests assert expected behavior and failure modes where practical.

tasks.title: Add unit tests for admin module
tasks.instructions: Create tests/test_admin.py with pytest unit tests covering the public functions and classes in src/admin.py. Follow the style of existing tests/test_auth.py and tests/test_users.py. Use monkeypatch, fixtures, or fake in-memory data for any databases or authorization checks. Ensure tests cover both successful operations and validation or permission failures.

tasks.title: Document exported TypeScript client types
tasks.instructions: Edit src/client/types.ts to add JSDoc comments for every exported type, interface, and key exported property. Describe the purpose of each type and its fields, including expected shapes, units, constraints, or defaults where relevant. Do not change any runtime or type behavior; only add documentation comments.

results.notes: Updated tests/test_admin.py to cover the public admin functions dashboard() and audit_log() with token validation, permission checks, success paths, and error propagation. The file imports audit_log/dashboard from src.admin and uses unittest.mock.patch to isolate src.admin.validate_token and src.admin.check_permissions, with a _make_valid_token helper for synthetic tokens. Tests cover dashboard stats on valid token, permission errors, audit-log entry creation, and invalid-token rejection. Note: cursor_code was already exhausted for this worktree and could not apply the requested revision refinements; the current diff still uses unittest.mock.patch rather than monkeypatch in test_dashboard_returns_stats, does not use pytest.raises/import pytest, and retains a hardcoded timestamp assertion in test_audit_log_returns_entry. These remaining revisions could not be applied within tool limits.

Edited src/client/types.ts (only file changed) via cursor-agent. Added JSDoc documentation only: a purpose blurb for each exported interface (CreateOrderRequest, Order, ChargeRequest, ChargeResult, LoginRequest, Session) and a JSDoc comment above every field covering role, expected shape, units (charge amount in smallest currency unit), optionality/defaults (currency falls back to server default), constraints (non-empty items, non-negative amount), and representative enum-like string values (status, currency ISO 4217). No exported type aliases exist in this file. Used {@link} cross-references between related types (Session.userId, Order.userId, ChargeRequest.amount). Verified via git_diff: the only changes are added comment blocks — no type signatures, member names/order, values, formatting, or runtime behavior were altered. Lint clean on the edited file.
